scope: Bounded source and synthetic-fixture audit for authenticating planning exporter semantic state before reusing export batches. This record does not qualify a real saved-project reload, bundled Ghidra run, GCC compiler-engine run, or production release.

anchors: new planning-batch preflight and post-write authentication:2039-2139
facts: Planning preflight fingerprints ordered function records, unique failure/global/type evidence and a terminal function count using a domain-separated SHA-256 stream.
The persisted schema-2 state includes the exporter/tool/input identities, function and batch counts, canonical byte count, semantic SHA-256 and the ordered batch-commitment SHA-256.
An existing state must equal the newly recomputed state byte-for-byte; legacy schema 1 state is rejected because it has no whole-program semantic binding.
Each retained batch is checked against the preflight commitment before reuse, and each newly serialized batch is checked before its checkpoint is published.
Raw checkpoint validation recomputes the inventory, ordered batch commitments and semantic fingerprint from captured function, failure, global and type records.
Interrupted prefixes are accepted only as an exact contiguous prefix; terminal prefixes and completed runs must reproduce the declared semantic and batch bindings.
After validation, the state, progress, checkpoint and four batch-fragment byte snapshots are reauthenticated before the assessment is returned.
